registers.name: CONTROL0
registers.description: Primary control register for global enable, soft reset, mode select, and safe-fallback selection. Bit assignments are packed into a single 8-bit host-visible register to remain compatible with the compact register window.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Global controller enable. When 0, request emission is suppressed and the control loop remains in safe fallback.

fields.name: SOFT_RESET
fields.description: Soft reset request. Writing 1 requests synchronous safe reset/clear behavior in the controller.

fields.name: MODE_SELECT
fields.description: Mode select. Encodes the control mode used in request packetization and safety policy selection.

fields.name: SAFE_FALLBACK_SELECT
fields.description: Fallback policy selection. Selects conservative default output or hold-last-safe behavior as implemented.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as 0.

fields.name: REQ_SEQ_SEED[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the request sequence seed.

fields.name: REQ_SEQ_SEED[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the request sequence seed.

registers.name: VELOCITY_SETPOINT_L
registers.description: Stream velocity setpoint low byte in m/s, used for request packetization.

fields.name: STREAM_VELOCITY_MPS[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the stream velocity setpoint.

registers.name: VELOCITY_SETPOINT_H
registers.description: Stream velocity setpoint high byte in m/s.

fields.name: STREAM_VELOCITY_MPS[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the stream velocity setpoint.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD_L
registers.description: Response timeout threshold low byte, counted in cycles or equivalent ticks.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the timeout threshold.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the timeout threshold.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_MIN_L
registers.description: Actuator command clamp minimum low byte.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MIN[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the minimum actuator clamp value.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_MIN_H
registers.description: Actuator command clamp minimum high byte.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MIN[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the minimum actuator clamp value.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_MAX_L
registers.description: Actuator command clamp maximum low byte.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MAX[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the maximum actuator clamp value.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_MAX_H
registers.description: Actuator command clamp maximum high byte.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MAX[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the maximum actuator clamp value.

registers.name: STATUS0
registers.description: Status register low byte containing active state and sticky fault summary bits.

fields.name: FAULT_VALID
fields.description: Indicates that at least one fault or blocking condition is active.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Indicates the controller is operating in fallback mode.

fields.name: DISABLE_STATE
fields.description: Indicates controller disable state.

fields.name: CLAMP_EVENT
fields.description: Sticky clamp indication from the safety supervisor.

fields.name: INVALID_PAYLOAD_FAULT
fields.description: Sticky invalid or malformed response indication.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_FAULT
fields.description: Sticky timeout indication.

fields.name: STALE_RESPONSE_FAULT
fields.description: Sticky stale/replayed/duplicate response indication.

fields.name: SEQUENCE_MISMATCH_FAULT
fields.description: Sticky response sequence mismatch indication.
